profile.headline: Software Engineer II
profile.summary: I have a diverse technical background, having worked in nuclear engineering, neurology, robotics, software development, physics, circuit/electrical systems design, event coordination, grant administration, data analysis, and everything in between. Through this, I have become a jack of all trades, often finding my niche in providing services that bridge the gap between the worlds of my many experiences and interests. Furthermore, I thoroughly enjoy teaching myself new skills and employing creative problem-solving to find solutions to difficult problems. I have worked in security, defense, and intelligence for over seven years, specializing in systems development and integration.

positions.title: Software Engineer II (62)
positions.description: As a member of the Azure SQL Silver team, I work to ensure both the functionality of Azure SQL in our air-gapped environments and work to introduce new updates and features.

positions.title: Senior Systems Engineer
positions.description: Leading projects and a team to support U.S. Government clients by providing systems development and integration through work with microcontrollers, single-board computers, and application development.

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description: Supporting U.S. Government clients by providing systems development and integration through work with microcontrollers, single-board computers, and application development.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: Member of the Global Defense Group, working primarily as a software engineer, but also offered services as a physicist, systems engineer, hardware engineer, electrical engineer, and technology researcher. I provided support for a variety of government clients.

positions.title: Science Festival Committee Member
positions.description: Served first as Volunteer Coordinator, Vice-Chair, then Chair across three consecutive years respectively of the Randolph College Science Festival Committee.

positions.title: Robotics Consultant
positions.description: Hired to lead after school program to teach middle and high school students the basics of robotics.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Assisted with various research fellows’ and graduate students’ research (frequently preparing, transferring, or monitoring samples)
•	Shadowed researchers during experiments/procedures of interest
•	Attended lectures and presentations of accomplished researchers
•	Developed, distributed, and managed various Python-based programs (in addition to authoring accompanying documentation) to improve lab efficiency (chiefly a file name randomizer for double-blind studies and the GENEsis program)

honors.title: Platinum Award for Passionate Service
honors.description: Improved efficiency in a time-critical system by ~85%, making the system a viable solution to the client's problem.
honors.issuer: Issued by Booz Allen Hamilton · Jan 2019

projects.title: Low-Speed Digital Signal Replicator
projects.description: Developed device capable of recording and replicating low-speed (less than 16 MHz) digital input signals as per user specifications

projects.title: GENEsis: A genetics data conversion program
projects.description:
•	Allows researchers to identify special or genetic classifications for unknown sets of data or convert know sets of genetic data between cross-species analogues, classes of identification, or properties within respective genes
•	Automatically ensures databases remain up-to-date, thus surpassing current alternatives which often use heavily outdated data
•	Program now used and managed by the Cardiff University Neuroscience and Mental Health Research Institute

publications.title: Thermal Analysis Method for Multilayer Ceramic Composite Fuel Cladding
publications.publisher: The American Ceramic Society 39th International Conference and Expo on Advanced Ceramics and Composites · Jan 1, 2015
